# Mindsnap: Gov Sherpa

Many moons ago, I participated in a hackathon at Ideo's beautiful HQ up in San Francisco. Our team landed on the idea of improving Government's user experience. (I was young, full of passion and that energy mixed with a techie designer to align on a very broad topic.)

Thus I found myself conducting intercept interviews on the SF boardwalk asking (no joke) "what is your experience with government?" The responses ranged from baffled to bewildered. It was quite illustrative as a collision of sorts between Silicon Valley culture and our democratic experiment in self government. 

The result of our discussion was the idea of "Gov Sherpa," a concierge service to help folks navigate the complexity of all the government -- services, permits, process, policies, the whole shebang. The rest of that summer I spent a lot of time showing up at events and bridging the world of digital tech and government. I also wrote a lot.


[Out of that collision came a zine: [California Revolution](https://drive.google.com/file/d/0BxXlPjHg1R6iYzN6cUxQbF9RTHc/view?usp=sharing&resourcekey=0-MPCp9wfvXvRtKoO_wTwEzQ). It was our attempt to capture what we heard on the boardwalk and imagine what government might feel like if it were designed with the same care as the products coming out of the Valley.] 


### Context on a mindsnap

[The name "mindsnap" comes from a trip down the Colorado River through the Grand Canyon. Every so often our guide would call the whole group together, beach the boats, and point everyone at the same thing, whether a band of rock laid down millions of years ago or an ancient granary tucked into the canyon wall, so we'd all share the same context before he dove into the story behind it. A mindsnap is my attempt at that moment: a quick pause to get us looking at the same idea before we explore it together. You can read more about that trip, and the remarkable guide who led it, in [Tommy: Grand Canyon Maestro, Maven, and Masterful River Guide](https://app.notion.com/p/jotpy/Tommy-Grand-Canyon-Maestro-Maven-and-Masterful-River-Guide-95f338f544cb411cb25ab4aa58690144?source=copy_link).]
